commands.command:
. /workspace/.setup/rust-env.sh
python3 tools/wtime-bench/compare.py --baseline target/performance/P032-before --candidate tools/wtime-bench/target/release/wtime-bench --candidate-mode decoded --selection scalar --pairs 30 --build-growth-explanation-file docs/benchmarks/performance/P032-build-decision.md --output target/performance/P032 > target/performance/P032-run.log 2>&1
commands.name: comparison

counts.warm_calibration_policy_limit: All 85 scalar workloads use bounded shared-batch calibration with both sides confirmed at or above 20 ms during calibration (164 typed-driver records and six legacy single-case records). Later timed observations can fall below 20 ms.

comparison.warm_calibration_limit: All 85 scalar workloads use bounded shared-batch calibration with both sides confirmed at or above 20 ms during calibration (164 typed-driver records and six legacy single-case records). Later timed observations can fall below 20 ms.

coverage_limits: The scalar workload and stage totals are derived from the immutable registry and independently checked against the journal.
Only decoded guest-call argument suffixes use the range constructor. Public calls, host boundaries, and the Reference executor retain checked/owned paths.
Focused path proof and full suites are correctness evidence; speed claims require the separate predeclared gate result.

All 85 scalar warm workloads use bounded shared-batch calibration with both sides confirmed at or above 20 ms (164 typed-driver and six legacy single-case records). Later timing observations may be shorter.

Removing the guest Arguments construction/event does not prove fewer allocator-wide allocations: predecessor frame setup reuses that vector for locals. All four timed primary targets have no extra nonparameter locals. Range-hit counters prove path selection only.
The single quiet build pair implements the predeclared budget decision; clean-time failure is not a robust causal compile-time claim.

Temporary helper reconstruction and synthetic checks establish tooling behavior only. Actual guest and timing evidence comes from retained executed commands, complete journals and source-bound reports.

development_failures.kind: candidate preflight guard rejected live source against predecessor before work
development_failures.correction: Compared preflight to frozen predecessor identities and checked candidate changes separately; successful semantic commands and the quiet sample ran once.

development_failures.kind: supporting provenance copy referenced missing helper filename
development_failures.correction: Recovered the exact previously executed failed helper hash from its recorded identity and completed remaining supporting copies without restarting timing.

development_failures.kind: temporary synthetic test overwrote helper drafts
development_failures.cause: The test wrote absolute /tmp provenance input paths instead of confining fixture writes to its fresh temporary root.
development_failures.observed_scope: Temporary helper drafts, tests and reviews only; measured repository sources, archived binaries, running comparison and durable executed evidence were intact.
development_failures.correction: Stopped writes, retained placeholders/bytecode and inventory, restored retained executed copies byte-for-byte, and reconstructed unavailable staged sources with fresh review. Hash equality is claimed only for verified exact recoveries. No comparison or quiet build sample was retried.
development_failures.stderr_limit: The original failed synthetic process output appeared in the tool transcript; reconstructed descriptions are not original captured stderr.
